en: Vintage sepia postcard with three ornate, baroque-style picture frames: on the left a person in traditional dress, in the center a well-dressed person in a long coat and hat holding a cane, and on the right a person in a ballet-style tutu. Under the central portrait is printed text with the name "John Lind" and a German subtitle. There is extensive handwritten cursive text across the lower part and along the right edge. On the left edge appears a vertical printer's imprint mentioning Hamburg.
